Definition: Jojada, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joiada or Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"; 1) son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem; 2) son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah
